description: This file defines the OrleansLifecycleCanceledException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a lifecycle was canceled, either by request or observer error. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable.

classes.name: OrleansLifecycleCanceledException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception that indicates a canceled lifecycle within Orleans runtime, derived from OrleansException.
